summary: Full backend + frontend testing of selfhost control panel. 13/13 backend pytest tests pass covering stats, projects CRUD/actions, deploy simulation (upload zip, 12s simulated deploy reaching progress=100 and status=live), deployment fetch/list, resources (24 points), and domains (invalid 400, duplicate 409, propagating -> active after ~8s, delete 200/404). Frontend Playwright E2E tests pass: dashboard loads with 4 stat cards, projects list renders 2 seeded projects with working start/stop/restart, resource charts (CPU/RAM/Disk) render with live %, zip upload auto-fills app name, deploy runs to 100% with streaming logs, domain add/propagate/delete works and invalid format shows error toast.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — consider migrating to lifespan context.
Deploy endpoint reads full file into memory; fine for MVP but not for large uploads.
Domain validation regex forbids single-label TLDs and IDN — acceptable for MVP.
run_deploy background task is not persisted; if backend restarts mid-deploy the deployment will be stuck in 'building'. Acceptable for simulated MVP.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds portfolio-site and crm-dashboard on startup when projects collection empty. Test created and cleaned up TEST_* projects and a temporary ui-test-app project during UI test (cleaned up post-run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL from /app/frontend/.env. Pytest requires -n 0 to run serially (pytest.ini forces xdist -n 2 which is fine too). Deployment simulation ~12s, domain propagation ~8s; use appropriate sleeps.
